Small shows land sponsors every week. The trick is to pitch brands your listeners already love,
and to show the brand why.

## Start with brands your listeners use

Make a list of the brands your listeners talk about. Your **comments**, your *reviews* and your inbox
all count. Read more on the [sample reports](/samples).

> A brand that already sells to your listeners needs less convincing.

## Send a short pitch

Keep the email under 150 words:

1. Who listens, in one line.
2. Why this brand fits them.
3. One offer with a price.

| Downloads per episode | Midroll rate |
| --- | --- |
| 1,000 | $25 |
| 5,000 | $125 |

## Follow up once

Wait a week, then send one short note. Run `say hello` if you must.

```text
Hi again, just checking this reached you.
```

### When they say no

Thank them and ask who else on their team buys ads.
